prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual 2D mobile game sprite, NOT a UI screenshot. Input image 1 is the master STYLE REFERENCE from our game Cep Madencisi, not an edit target. Produce ONE isolated asset only on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Straight-on orthographic front view with zero perspective tilt. Preserve the polished hand-painted faceted-rock style of the reference: restrained chunky bevel, upper-left highlights, dark lower-right edge, crisp readable silhouette, no photorealism. Object centered, roughly 800x800 px overall and fully within canvas with generous even transparent padding. No scene, floor, wall, frame, label, text, letter, digit, watermark, extra objects or baked ground shadow. The game engine will render all durability numbers separately, so the CENTRAL AREA MUST BE BLANK and calm enough for white text. No checkerboard drawn into image. This must look like an individual usable piece of the exact reference game, not a new art style. Subject: ONLY the slate-blue square stone block at far LEFT in reference 1, but REMOVE its numeral completely. Square shape with slightly clipped/chamfered corners, about 800x800 px, not a tall rectangle. Slate blue face #27394B with lighter muted blue bevel. Keep a few broad subtle rock facets toward edges, flat quiet center for future number overlay. Do not add a gem, cracks implying damage, or any icon.
